digestDescription: A short summary: what changed today and which decisions wait for you.
proposalText: I've prepared a proposal — it needs your decision.
assignedText: I've assigned the task — the result will appear here when the agent finishes.
rejected: You declined — I won't propose this again for {days} days.
expired: The decision expired without an answer — the task is closed.

BUDGET.fix: raise the budget in project rules or the agent's limit

AGENT_GONE.fix: give the task to another agent

STEP_LIMIT.what: the agent ran out of steps
STEP_LIMIT.fix: make the task more specific and retry

LLM_UNAVAILABLE.what: the AI model did not respond

INTERNAL.fix: retry; contact support if it persists

turnPaused: This agent is paused — write to the manager or resume the agent.
checkNoVerdict: The check ended without a verdict
